1.consolidated_definition: econ. Venta. Venta de un producto a precios más bajos del costo para adueñarse del mercado. Anglicismo crudo, poco frecuente. DRAE 2001, voz inglesa. Retornaron con agresividad con subsidios del gobierno canadiense al conseguir la equivalencia de calidad, pero estuvieron hasta que se les probó en el World Trade Comission actos depredadores o dumping, explicó Cordero Toledo (Cámara de Representantes, 26-10-06)
1.en_consolidated_definition: Econ. Sale. The sale of a product at prices lower than its cost to gain control of the market. Raw anglicism, infrequently used. Returned with aggressiveness with Canadian government subsidies upon achieving quality equivalence, but they stayed until their predatory acts or dumping were proven in the World Trade Commission, explained Cordero Toledo (House of Representatives, 26-10-06)
